method: Timetable for 2026-10-27 (the Tuesday to Thursday with most trips in the next three weeks). Platforms inside Helsinki where a line picks up passengers that day, grouped by name and type within 300 m. Departures from 7:00 to 9:00, both directions together. Route shapes: the most used shape per line and direction, simplified to 3 m and cut at the Helsinki border. Line numbers only. Not live data.
